title: Joe Rogan Experience #2255 - Mark Zuckerberg
summary: A nearly three-hour Joe Rogan interview with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, covering Meta's products, AI, smart glasses, and his views on culture and company direction. The conversation is wide-ranging and long-form.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for what Zuckerberg says in his own words, such as on AI writing most new code, WhatsApp, and Apple interoperability.

quote.text: I think a reasonable person would also listen to what he says about his own motivations.
